author: dilates
body:
In Game Name:Dilates

Reason of Ban:Aimbot/Hacking

Why I Should be Unbanned: I believe I should be unbanned, for the major reason, that it's been two years since I was banned. I really love the gamemodes on this server (Including Nebula) and I heavily wish to play here once again. I believe that the fact that I have been banned for two years now, is a valid reason as to why I should be unbanned. I no longer hack, nor have I hacked in a long, long time.

I hope my appeal gets accepted and I can play on the server as soon as possible!
